As US President, he tried to keep the US out of the First World War, but he finally sent US soldiers to join the Allied forces in 1917, saying that 'the world must be made safe for democracy. ex: They’ve done a workmanlike job.
他们活儿做得很精细。

en: the skill with which somebody makes something, especially when this affects the way it looks or works
ex: Our buyers insist on high standards of workmanship and materials.
我们的买主对工艺和材料坚持要高标准。

zh: 一起工作的人；同事；工友
en: a person that you work with, often doing the same job, in an office, a factory, etc.
ex: Her workmates organized a leaving party for her last day in the office.
同事为她举办了欢送会，纪念她在办公室工作的最后一天。

en: a period of physical exercise that you do to keep fit
ex: She does a 20-minute workout every morning.
她每天早晨做运动 20 分钟。

zh: 工件（指使用工具或机器加工或生产的物件）
en: an item that is being worked on with a tool or a machine
ex: Clamp smaller workpieces to a bench.
将较小的工件夹紧到工作台上。

en: the office, factory, etc. where people work
ex: the introduction of new technology into the workplace
把新技术引进工厂

en: a room in which work is done, especially work that involves making things
ex: The jeweller has a workroom at the back of his shop.
珠宝商在他的店铺后面有一间作坊。

zh: 职工委员会（负责和雇主协商工作条件等）
en: a group of employees who represent all the employees at a factory, etc. in discussions with their employers over conditions of work
a piece of paper or an electronic document on which there is a series of questions and exercises to be done by a student
a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience
ex: There will be the opportunity for practical theatre work in drama workshops.
在戏剧工作坊中将有机会进行实际的戏剧工作。

en: a space in which to work, especially in an office
the desk and computer at which a person works; one computer that is part of a computer network
a flat surface in a kitchen for preparing food on
ex: The kitchen has granite worktops.
厨房配有花岗岩台面。

zh: a medical examination of a patient in order to say exactly what an illness or the cause of a problem is
en: a medical examination of a patient in order to say exactly what an illness or the cause of a problem is
ex: The patient underwent a diagnostic workup.
病人接受了诊断检查。

zh: 一周的工作时间；工作周
en: the total amount of time that you spend at work during the week
